title: Bakkt, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Bakkt, Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing the results of its reconvened special stockholder meeting on April 17, 2026, where shareholders approved an issuance of shares equal to 31.5% of outstanding Class A Common Stock in connection with the company's planned acquisition of Distributed Technologies Research Global Ltd. (DTR).
key_points: The special meeting was reconvened on April 17, 2026 after originally being convened and adjourned on March 24, 2026.
A quorum was established with 13,266,200 shares (51.49% of voting power) present in person, by remote communication, or by proxy.
The Issuance Proposal was approved with 12,999,817 votes for, 229,734 against, and 36,649 abstentions.

The share issuance equals 31.5% of shares outstanding immediately prior to the DTR acquisition closing, including fully diluted shares from options, warrants, and convertible securities but excluding existing warrants.
CEO Akshay Naheta is among the beneficial owners of DTR receiving shares under the approved issuance.
The Adjournment Proposal was not required as sufficient votes were obtained for the Issuance Proposal.
why_it_matters: This filing represents a corporate governance action for a single publicly traded company. It does not contain information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. The acquisition-related share issuance may dilute existing shareholders but represents only one company's equity issuance with no systemic market implications.
